 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from today's five Serie A games: Inter-Fiorentina, Genoa-Venezia, Atalanta-Frosinone, Lecce-Juventus, and Udinese-Milan.
 We begin at 12:30 CET [11:30 GMT] with Inter hosting Fiorentina at San Siro.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Nerazzurri need a win to catch Lazio at the top of the Serie A table after Gennaro Gattuso's side beat Parma 2-1 on Saturday. 
 The afternoon games, both starting at 15:00 CET, are Genoa-Venezia and Atalanta-Frosinone.
 Only one point separates Venezia and Genoa after the Lagunari won their first match under Davide Nicola last week. Venezia remain bottom of the league with three points, but Parma, Fiorentina, Genoa and Udinese are just one point above them.
 Juventus visit Eusebio Di Francesco's Lecce at 18:00 CET, and Serie A Week 8 ends at 20:45 with Milan's away game at Udinese.
 Juventus have earned just five points in their last five Serie A matches, with two draws, two defeats, and one win.
 Milan, on the other hand, remain unbeaten in Serie A but have managed just two wins and three draws in their last five.
